protocol.criterion: development-subject mean validation log loss; held-out subjects never select configuration
protocol.baselineNote: EMA is a fully specified illustrative heuristic. Baseline beta=3 is the synthetic generating beta; no handicap from scale mismatch.
protocol.intervalNote: Descriptive normal intervals plus paired subject-level percentile bootstrap differences (2000 resamples). Exploratory, not multiplicity-adjusted or real-user confidence. Drift coverage is diagnostic against changed true weights.
protocol.hardPolicyNote: Normalized eligible feature space only. Payment invariants tested separately with signed records.
